messages:
mike: FYI saw a permissions gap in prod: service A -> gateway -> service B. The original user identity isn't showing up in Service B's audit logs.

anya: repro notes? which header or token is being lost on the hop?

mike: Service A receives user-scoped API key and calls gateway with operator token. Gateway calls Service B but we only see gateway principal there. We expect original user for RBAC checks and audit.

sophia: sounds like a delegation problem. We either need a reliable "original-actor" header that proxies append to, or proper cryptographic delegation.

diego: quick tradeoffs: 1) append-only actor chain headers (cheap, fast, no crypto). 2) signed delegation token (JWT) issued by calling service and verified by downstream. 3) introspect via delegation-service (central authority validates).

anya: constraints: router/gateway should be able to make authz decisions without always hitting delegation-service. So prefer local verifiable tokens.

sophia: proposal: add headers: `X-RW-Actor-Orig`, `X-RW-Actor-Chain`, and `X-RW-Delegation-JWT`. Gateway preserves `X-RW-Actor-Orig` if present and appends itself to the chain.

mike: example flow:
```
# initial
X-RW-Actor-Orig: user:alice@org:zen
X-RW-Actor-Chain: user:alice@org:zen
X-RW-Delegation-JWT: (signed by service-a)
# after gateway
X-RW-Actor-Orig: user:alice@org:zen
X-RW-Actor-Chain: user:alice@org:zen,gateway-01
X-RW-Delegation-JWT: (signed by service-a)
```

diego: jwt fields should include `orig`, `iss`, `scope` (org/project), `iat`, `exp`, and `sig_kid`. Important: include explicit scope to avoid org->project escalation.

anya: verification cost concern: verifying JWT sig per request could add CPU. We can mitigate by caching verified delegation signatures in gateway (LRU) and only hitting crypto on cache misses. Also consider ED25519 to be faster.

sophia: security policy: no gateway should be able to forge `X-RW-Actor-Orig` without a valid delegation JWT. So when gateway receives an operator token + delegation jwt it can forward both; downstream must validate jwt before treating `X-RW-Actor-Orig` as authoritative. If validation fails, treat call as gateway-only actor.

mike: migration plan suggestion: phase 1 (1 week): enforce append-only chain header and log occurrences where `X-RW-Actor-Orig` is missing; phase 2 (2-3 weeks): rollout Delegation JWT creation in caller services and verification in gateway/downstream with feature flag; phase 3: require verified delegation jwt in prod for cross-service impersonation.

diego: ops: add telemetry counters: `delegation.jwt.present`, `delegation.jwt.validated`, `delegation.unverified_forwarded`. We'll use those to measure cutover.

anya: bump: how do we rotate delegation signing keys? should be per-service with central public key discovery via our key-service (jwks endpoint). Add `sig_kid` in jwt header to find key. Key rotation doc needed.

sophia: one more edge: batched async calls where gateway fans out to many downstreams. We must attach the same delegation jwt to each request. If tok has short TTL, caching/refresh concerns. Recommend TTL ~5m for delegation tokens and reissue when crossing trust boundary significantly later.

mike: infra-bot: opened canary `delegation-jwt-gateway-canary-2026-03-22` targeting us-east-1 gateways. Logs live in /infra/canaries/delegation-jwt.

infra-bot: Canary created. Remember to include rollout steps in PR description.

diego: docs + SDK: add helpers in our client libs to attach delegation jwt when invoking another service on behalf of a user. Also add server-side middleware to validate and populate `effective_actor` and `original_actor`.

anya: test matrix: unit parse/verify jwt, integration chain of 4 hops with mix of legacy and new proxies, perf benchmark at 1k rps with jwt verify enabled.

sophia: OK let's ship phase 1 today: append-only header + telemetry + flag. I'll open a router PR and add verification stub behind feature flag.

mike: thanks all. I'll draft RFC follow-up with the phased rollout and ownership. Tagging @anya @sophia @diego for reviews. :white_check_mark:
